verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document any user-configurable automation or workflow builder that runs autonomously in the background. The API and webhooks are developer building blocks a programmer could use to build automations, and the MCP tools are invoked on demand by the user's AI client. Fixed built-in behaviors (AI scoring, the AI Notetaker, automatic reminders, Calendly-driven stage moves) are adjacent features, not automations the user sets up, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
